features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION REQUIRES PHP 8.4.1 — The previous ones ran on PHP 8.2. If your server has an older version the program tells you so and stops before touching a single file: your installation stays intact. To update PHP, go into your hosting control panel, under «PHP version» or «PHP Selector». Three extensions that were not required before are also needed: gd, intl and mbstring, enabled from the same panel. The most important is gd: without it the program installs but produces no PDF at all — no breakdowns, no instalment schedules, no F24 forms.

IMPORTING FROM ANOTHER PROGRAM — From «Condomini → Importa dati» (Buildings → Import data) you upload your old program's export and the whole building comes in at once: people, units, ownerships, thousandths tables (ownership shares per thousand) and opening balances, where until now it was retyped row by row. First source supported: Danea Domustudio. Preview screens only read — nothing is stored until you press «Importa» (Import) — and balances do not go in unless they add up. At the end you get a PDF report to attach to the minutes. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/importare-dati-altro-gestionale.html

BACKUP AND RESTORE FROM THE PANEL — Under «Impostazioni → Gestione backups» (Settings → Backup management) you create a full copy of database, documents and configuration whenever you want, and download it as a zip: no terminal, no mysqldump, no cron. It works in small resumable steps, so it holds up on shared hosting too, it can be encrypted with AES-256 and old copies delete themselves. Next to every archive there is «Ripristina» (Restore), which takes the installation back to that state, applying the migrations needed by itself. ⚠️ For this update, though, make a copy of the database from your hosting control panel: the automatic backup runs before the migrations, and on 1.9.1 that machinery does not exist yet. From the next update on it stands on its own. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/backup.html

WITHHOLDING TAX AND THE F24 FORM — Under «Movimenti» (Transactions) there is «Ritenute e F24» (Withholdings and F24), the schedule that answers the question of the 16th of the month: do I have to pay, and how much. Until now the «Debiti verso l'Erario» (Tax payables) account only knew how to fill up, and the entry that clears it did not exist. The two thresholds are kept apart — € 500,00 for contract work at 4%, € 100,00 for professionals at 20% — and for each payment order you print the slip for online banking or the F24 form in triplicate, listing the payments covered. ⚠️ With a bonifico parlante (traceable transfer) the building withholds nothing, because the bank does it: before, the withholding was applied anyway, so the supplier was paid 4% less than due. Re-check payments marked as bonifico parlante with a non-zero withholding. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/versare-ritenute-f24-condominio.html

JOURNAL AND BALANCE SHEET — Under «Movimenti» (Transactions) you will find the journal: every entry of the financial year in date order, with search on description and reference number, filters by type, status and period, and the debit and credit totals of what you are looking at. Alongside it comes the balance sheet, which says in plain language whether the books add up, what the likely cause is when they do not, and offers the button that puts it right. The opening balance of a cash account is now a real entry with a counter-entry: the figure does not change, but an amount coming in without one produces a visible imbalance instead of staying hidden. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/libro-giornale-condominio.html

TRANSFERS BETWEEN CASH ACCOUNTS AND FUNDS — The «Giroconti» (Internal transfers) item in the «Movimenti» (Transactions) menu is live: you move money from the bank to a fund, from a fund to the bank or between funds, with reference number, description, preview and reversal always possible. This is where cover from the reserve fund is confirmed. ⚠️ Two things change: a fund is reduced when you confirm the transfer and no longer when you record the invoice, and money set aside in funds no longer counts as available liquidity — anyone with well-stocked funds will see availability drop, and that is the truth the old calculation hid.

WHAT OWNERS HAVE ALREADY PAID IN IS NOT ASKED FOR TWICE — If a building arrives with money already collected — last year's resolution, € 500,00 each for refurbishment works — you record it unit by unit under «Già versato» (already paid in), against the expense item it belongs to, and the breakdown asks only for the remainder instead of for the whole cost a second time. Quick fill spreads the total by thousandths and every row can still be corrected by hand, with the effect on the next instalment plan visible before you save. Anyone who has paid more than their share gets no automatic credit: they are asked for zero and the excess appears in the Inbox. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/gia-versato-condominio.html

CARRIED-OVER BALANCES CAN BE CORRECTED, AND ARE NOT SHUT AWAY FOR EVER — Pressing «Ricalcola» (Recalculate) on a plan that included prior balances was enough to make them vanish without warning, and from then on they stayed frozen: not editable, not deletable, never included in any later plan. Now every balance records which plan absorbed it, a recalculation gives back the same shares, and deleting a plan reopens the balances it was holding shut. A migration repairs affected installations on its own. ⚠️ Who pays a unit's prior balance changes too: the tenant is out of it, because they owe the building nothing — on € 1.000,00 the owner paid € 500,00 and the rest landed on people who did not owe it. On a unit held in full ownership nothing changes. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/gestione-saldi-iniziali-condominio.html

MONEY THE BREAKDOWN COULD NOT ALLOCATE NO LONGER VANISHES — A plan with € 35.661,60 of chapters generated € 2.400,00, and the other € 33.261,60 ended up nowhere: not in an instalment, not in a warning, not in an error. It happened with a chapter with no table attached, an empty table or one with zero thousandths, percentages or role splits adding up to less than 100, a holder with a zero share. With several tables it was worse, because the amount was redistributed over the others: people with nothing to do with it paid, and the books still balanced. Generation now stops, says which chapter and how much is missing, and you can go ahead by giving a reason.

ON MEETING DOCUMENTS THE FIGURES MATCH THE ACCOUNTS — In the breakdown by table the column totals did not match the item's budget: in a real 44-unit building the water column closed at € 2.199,96 instead of € 2.200,00, and the odd cents turned up on unrelated columns. In another case a € 1.000,00 column printed € 1.214,36, because arrears and «Già versato» (already paid in) were loaded onto the thousandths columns although they have opposite signs. Every column now adds up to the budget of its accounts, and the two quantities get a column each. Two new documents: the owner's statement of account in PDF and the breakdown by expense item. ⚠️ Anyone reprinting a breakdown already issued will see the same row and grand totals, but some columns change value.

AN OWNER'S CREDIT NO LONGER DISAPPEARS — An instalment paid for more than it was worth vanished from the «Nuovo incasso» (New payment received) list and the outstanding amount came out inflated: one administrator collected € 173,80 twice because the form kept offering it. Those instalments now appear as credit rows, the outstanding amount is always the real one, and the excess stays attached as a credit that can be spent on later instalments. You see it without looking for it: a card in the statement of account, a panel on the dashboard saying which instalment that credit covers, and a note when you issue new instalments. No automatic entries: the decision stays yours. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/registrare-incasso-rate-condominio.html

INVOICES AND PAYMENTS NO LONGER LOSE PIECES ALONG THE WAY — Invoices at a 0% rate (bank charges, flat-rate suppliers, till receipts) were saved at 22% even though the preview showed the right amount: if you have recorded expenses without VAT, check them again. Reopening an invoice for editing no longer wrecks its figures — charges were multiplied and € 2,50 became € 25.000,00, the withholding tax went to zero, bonifico parlante (traceable transfer) and tax relief were lost, and a credit note saved again turned into an expense, doubling the debt. The «netto da pagare» (net payable) you read before saving is now the one saved. Every invoice has a «Registra pagamento» (Record payment) action, opening the form ready filled in. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/registrare-fattura-passiva-condominio.html

INSTALMENTS FALL DUE WHEN YOU SAY SO — The instalment plan has a «Prima scadenza» (First due date) field, asked for by three administrators: the starting point was hard-wired to the beginning of the financial year, so you could not say «the first instalment on 30 September». Leave it empty and it starts as before; the screen shows the date it would use. An extraordinary plan now gathers in one document both the costs from linked invoices and the chapters entered by hand, and at last spreads past invoices over instalments, which before produced no share. A general plan excludes by itself the items already covered by other active plans, instead of asking for them twice. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/quando-scadono-rate-condominio.html

ACTUALS ALONGSIDE THE BUDGET — The chart of accounts has a «Consuntivo» (Actual) column: for every item you read what was budgeted and what has been spent, with overspent items in red, and clicking the amount opens the list of transactions behind it. ⚠️ This version corrects saved data: opening «Modifica» (Edit) on an item already overspent and saving silently replaced the approved budget with the amount spent, even without touching the field. The «Importo» (Amount) field is now called «Preventivo» (Budget) and shows the approved figure: where you read € 6.000,00 against a budget of € 5.000,00 you now read € 5.000,00. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/piano-dei-conti-condominio.html

SMALL EXPENSES WITHOUT INVENTING A SUPPLIER — From «Movimenti» (Transactions) you record in seconds the expenses that arise and are settled at the same moment — duties, bank charges, direct debits — giving amount, description, chapter and cash account: the system creates a single entry, cost against bank, without opening any supplier ledger. Before, for a € 2,50 charge, you had to invent a supplier called «Banca» (Bank), issue an invoice and pay it. The chapter stays attached, so budget and breakdown work just as they do for an invoice. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/piccole-spese-senza-fattura-condominio.html

SHARED HOSTING, EMAIL AND SECURITY — Behind services such as Altervista or Cloudflare the application did not recognise the secure connection and the browser blocked CSS and JavaScript: pages with no styling and buttons that did not respond. The trusted proxies setting was read too early during start-up and stayed inactive on every installation; it now works, and with it the real IP address the anti-abuse limits on login and 2FA depend on. Sending email no longer fails silently. Suspending a user now really suspends them, and at once. And whoever manages users can no longer grant privileges they do not hold themselves, nor grant them to themselves. Guide: https://kondomanager.com/docs/users.html

LISTS, DOCUMENTS AND RECORDS — Sorting a list now really sorts every record and no longer the ten on the page you are looking at, and each table remembers how many rows you want to see, for you and for that list. Upload limits are now the real ones: the screen said 10 MB, the check accepted 20 and the server of the person who reported it stopped at 2; every upload point now asks the server how much it can accept and states it. A downloaded document no longer loses its extension, the room count accepts half rooms, and a document's description and a unit's flat number are no longer required — an outdoor parking space does not have one.
